design_points.fallback_plan: Keep the PyTorch block driver as the only runnable path and hold BPU compilation.
design_points.lladacpp_design_point: Use block-wise denoising windows instead of treating every step as arbitrary-length decoding.
required_tests: truth case can enter a fixed block driver
design_points.risk: A fixed block driver can still be numerically wrong if token masks, position ids, or timestep semantics differ from HF truth.
design_points.s100p_equivalent_implementation: Define fixed block sizes 16, 32, and 64 with static input/output tensor contracts before any full-model graph attempt.
design_points.why_it_matters_for_dllm: A dLLM has many masked positions early and fewer later; block windows expose dense work to an accelerator.

design_points.fallback_plan: Disable speculation and run one-block denoising only.
design_points.lladacpp_design_point: Admit future-block draft tokens when current-block masked-token count becomes too small.
required_tests: draft tokens do not alter commit order
latency trace records admitted draft count
quality gate compares against full logits
design_points.risk: Speculation can hurt quality if draft state leaks into stable tokens.
design_points.s100p_equivalent_implementation: Represent draft tokens in the scheduler but forbid them from updating committed prefix state until accepted by strict rules.
design_points.why_it_matters_for_dllm: Late denoising steps underfill NPU/BPU compute; speculative draft work keeps dense kernels useful.

design_points.fallback_plan: Require all visible tokens to be stable before commit, accepting lower speed.
design_points.lladacpp_design_point: Keep early visible tokens revisable and refresh unstable tokens through a sparse side path.
design_points.risk: Revision state bugs can make output appear stable while logits truth disagrees.
design_points.s100p_equivalent_implementation: Track visible, stable, and revisable masks in CPU-side state; let BPU focus on dense block denoising until a verified sparse path exists.
design_points.why_it_matters_for_dllm: dLLM tokens may become visible before they are truly stable; correctness needs revision without stalling dense accelerator passes.

design_points.fallback_plan: Disable cache reuse for correctness gates.
design_points.lladacpp_design_point: Reuse prefix KV state across denoising steps and invalidate only the affected sparse regions.
design_points.risk: Bad invalidation can preserve stale hidden state and pass only synthetic cases.
design_points.s100p_equivalent_implementation: Start with CPU reference cache hashes and version ids; only promote to BPU visible buffers after layer-level truth passes.
design_points.why_it_matters_for_dllm: Repeated denoising revisits the same prefix; recomputing it wastes CPU and BPU time.

design_points.fallback_plan: Use full logits for every correctness gate.
design_points.lladacpp_design_point: Skip redundant logits for tokens already stable, especially when lm_head pressure dominates.
design_points.risk: Skipping logits before truth exists can hide correctness failures.
design_points.s100p_equivalent_implementation: Compute logits only for active or uncertain positions after a full-logits comparison proves identical decisions.
design_points.why_it_matters_for_dllm: Vocabulary-sized logits are expensive and memory-heavy; stable positions do not need repeated output projection.

design_points.fallback_plan: Run with explicit per-step allocation for debug, then optimize after truth gates pass.
design_points.lladacpp_design_point: Use graph-guided NPU-visible memory mapping and pipelined staging.
design_points.risk: Memory staging can make a numerically wrong graph look like a performance issue.
design_points.s100p_equivalent_implementation: Define S100P BPU buffer classes for weights, KV/revision state, token state, logits/confidence, and double-buffered staging.
design_points.why_it_matters_for_dllm: Repeated denoising makes remap and transfer cost part of the inner loop, not only model load.

design_points.fallback_plan: Hold at operator alignment and request vendor/compiler metadata for seg00_01.
design_points.lladacpp_design_point: Treat accelerator support as a library of validated ops, not a single opaque full graph.
design_points.risk: Missing vendor source graph or quant metadata can block closure.
design_points.s100p_equivalent_implementation: Build per-op and per-layer gates for embedding, position/RoPE, RMSNorm, QKV, attention, MLP, residual, and lm_head.
design_points.why_it_matters_for_dllm: Current Dream7B evidence localizes failures around early segment contracts; full-graph pass/fail is too coarse.

design_points.fallback_plan: Keep sensitive layers and lm_head higher precision.
design_points.lladacpp_design_point: Treat quantization as a runtime and quality loop, not only offline weight compression.
design_points.risk: Current seg00_01 failures could be worsened by unverified activation scaling.
design_points.s100p_equivalent_implementation: Start with W8A16, record activation ranges by layer, then try W4 only after W8 passes logits gates.
design_points.why_it_matters_for_dllm: Low-bit paths can change confidence, token stability, and final logits decisions.

design_points.fallback_plan: Report fixed-task-only success and keep product route locked.
design_points.lladacpp_design_point: Validate on fixed output lengths and block tasks before claiming broad generation.
design_points.risk: Fixed-task success can be overclaimed as general dialogue.
design_points.s100p_equivalent_implementation: Use eight fixed tasks: command, JSON plan, NAS intent, summary, infill, rewrite, Chinese normalization, and safety refusal.
design_points.why_it_matters_for_dllm: A block runtime can pass narrow tensor tests but still fail format, stability, or semantic quality.

directly_actionable_now: Create the isolated track directory and safety boundaries.
Freeze the v21 baseline into Phase 0 reports.
Define truth-case schema and operator manifest requirements.
Keep generation, product routing, 18888/18889, and OpenClaw foreground untouched.
hold_conditions: If full 31-row PyTorch truth is missing, hold at external_truth_missing_hold.
If position, embedding, or lm_head op alignment fails, stop block runtime.
If only fixed tasks pass, do not claim general dialogue deployment.
requires_new_implementation: PyTorch block-wise diffusion driver with token state trace.
BPU per-op and layer alignment harness.
Static block graph compiler path for S100P.
